battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Battery size: {bms}. Check it against your packs' rated capacity and adjust if needed.

data_description.battery_kwh: Enter 0 to work it out from the log.
data_description.pack_discharge_a: 0 learns it from the log. A pack offline lowers this limit, which is how missing packs are spotted.

data_description.array_names: One name per MPPT input, comma-separated, for example South,East,West.
data_description.mppt_limits_a: Amps per MPPT input in the same order, for example 26,26,15. Leave empty to skip this check.

data_description.service_charge: Left out of the solar value, since you pay it either way.
data_description.utility_name: Used in advice such as asking your utility about line voltage.
data_description.hv_act: Typical grid-tie over-voltage trip is 110% of nominal (264 V on 240 V). Check your inverter's setting.
data_description.hv_watch: Watch when line voltage gets this close to the trip. 260 V is 4 V under a 264 V trip.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The EG4 Monitor Center rejected the saved login. Enter your current password.

manual.title: EG4 Monitor Center account
manual.description: Sign in with the account you use for the EG4 Monitor Center website. This is unofficial access and is not affiliated with EG4. Your login is stored only in Home Assistant.

user.title: EG4 Monitor Center account
user.description: You already have the EG4 Web Monitor integration. This report can sign in with the same EG4 account, so you don't have to type it again.

menu_options.reuse_web_monitor: Use my EG4 Web Monitor account

location.title: Where should the report go?
location.description: The report is a page of cards: verdict, findings, charts and tables. Put it on its own dashboard, or add it as a tab to a dashboard you already use. You can change this later under Configure.

error.invalid_auth: The Monitor Center rejected that username or password. Use your Monitor Center account name, which may not be your email (it is the same one the EG4 Web Monitor integration uses).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Monitor Center. Check the server and try again.
error.no_inverters: No inverters were found on this station.
error.no_arrays: Enter at least one array name.
error.bad_mppt_limits: Enter one number per array, in the same order as the names.
error.web_monitor_no_login: The EG4 Web Monitor integration has no cloud login to share (it may be set up for a local connection). Enter your account below.
error.username_case: EG4 rejected the login. Your username differs from the one EG4 Web Monitor uses only in capital letters or spaces. Check the first letter: phone keyboards often capitalise it.
error.username_differs: EG4 rejected the login. The username isn't the one EG4 Web Monitor signs in with. Use that account name, or choose "Use my EG4 Web Monitor account".
error.password_case: EG4 rejected the login. The username is right; the password differs only in capital letters or spaces.
error.password_differs: EG4 rejected the login. The username is right but the password isn't the one EG4 Web Monitor uses.
error.same_login_rejected: EG4 rejected the login, although it matches EG4 Web Monitor's. Check the Server choice: EG4 Web Monitor may use a different server.

abort.already_configured: This station is already set up.

data_description.weekly_day: The weekly report covers the 7 days ending on this day.
data_description.outage_entity: A binary sensor that is on while the system is off-grid.
data_description.outage_delay_minutes: Gives the EG4 cloud time to catch up before the report runs.
data_description.notify_service: For example notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Leave empty for no pushes.
data_description.known_issues: Comma-separated finding IDs to report as Info instead of Watch or Act.
data_description.battery_kwh: Found at setup from the EG4 integration or the battery itself. 0 works it out from the log.
data_description.pack_discharge_a: 0 learns it from the log (the highest limit seen, divided by the pack count).
data_description.temp_unit: Used for every temperature in the report and its chart.
data_description.report_location: Where the report page goes. Changing it adds the report there; it doesn't remove it from the old place.
data_description.hv_watch: Watch when line voltage gets this close to the trip. 260 V is 4 V under a 264 V trip.
data_description.hv_act: Typical grid-tie over-voltage trip is 110% of nominal (264 V on 240 V). Check your inverter's setting.

temperatures.title: Temperature thresholds
temperatures.description: In the unit you picked. Watch shows in the report only; Act can push if you chose Act notifications.

data_description.temp_heatsink_watch: A normal summer peak can reach about 93 °C, so the default leaves room above it.

generate.name: Generate report
generate.description: Download the EG4 data for a range and analyze it.

config_entry_id.name: Station
config_entry_id.description: Which station to report on. Leave empty for all.

period.name: Period
period.description: Today, or the 7 days ending on the end date. Defaults to the Report Period entity.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day of the report. Defaults to the Report End Date entity.
